title: Station Platform ABC
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child navigating a station with an adult
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Station Platform ABC a passenger-flow map: arrive, read, queue, pass gates, wait behind the edge, board through vestibules, and exit; train hardware is distinguished from passenger-facing station objects.
